XHelpers Pro 1.0.13 (31)
- AI Usage adds guided recovery and improves Claude sign-in renewal while keeping available usage readings current. - Cleanup tools preserve previous choices, scan coverage, reports, and recoverable sessions. Duplicate reviews add search and focused exact-copy scans. - App removal improves batch review, explains paused plans, and keeps recovery sessions available while Put Back is working. - File utilities and app installers provide clearer progress, results, and cancellation, including confirmation before stopping an installation. - Text and Markdown editors open at a useful size, with improved outline navigation and layouts that fit the available screen. - Window outlines preserve your chosen color when other windows temporarily change their appearance. - Quitting and restarting for a language change correctly closes open sheets. - Updated translations in all 25 supported languages.
